help.title: Help
help.intro: MeetingLens is a development preview for reviewing local meeting transcripts and testing the desktop workflow.
help.availableBody: You can use Summary mode to paste or import UTF-8 TXT, SRT and VTT transcripts, review bounded pages, correct text and speaker names, and manage transcript sources locally. The existing synthetic meeting and document workflows remain available.
help.unavailableBody: User-facing DeepSeek generation and formal AI-minutes results, recording, realtime transcription, screen capture, speaker diarization, realtime translation, video import and Docling product orchestration are not available yet. The Rust-only DeepSeek provider and consent foundation are implemented, but Generate remains disabled.
help.quickStartBody: Open Summary mode, paste notes or choose a TXT, SRT or VTT transcript, then review sources and correct the normalized segments. Minutes generation remains disabled.
help.filesBody: Open a meeting and use Add files. Approved files are copied into private application storage and can be deleted without changing the source file. Docling is not connected to this UI yet.
help.deepseekBody: Use Settings to save the key in Windows Credential Manager. The WebView cannot read it back. The Rust-only DeepSeek provider consumes it only when executing a frozen, explicitly authorized Summary run; the current user-facing Generate action is not wired yet.
help.privacyBody: Submitted transcript segments stay in MeetingLens private local storage. Unsubmitted pasted text is cleared on cancel or after saving, and source paths never reach the WebView. The current user-facing Generate action is disabled; the Rust provider can send only a frozen transcript scope after explicit confirmation.
help.faqBody: Changing the interface language does not translate transcript content or change the future minutes output language. Clearing WebView storage resets only the interface-language preference, not local meetings or transcripts.
help.feedbackBody: When reporting a problem, include the action, safe error code and application version. Never attach API keys, recordings, meeting content, local databases or private paths.
help.guidesBody: The repository includes matching Simplified Chinese and English development-preview guides.
